aboutPage.heroDesc: Authorized overseas sample factory of Shanghai WISER Machinery Co., Ltd. and strategic partner of Sidefu Linen, delivering turnkey industrial laundry excellence worldwide.
aboutPage.sec1Desc: Established in Shanghai, China, Shanghai WISER Machinery Co., Ltd. is a premier manufacturer of industrial laundry systems, soft-mount high-extract washers, chest flatwork ironers, and automatic folders with CE, ISO 9001, and ISO 14001 certifications.
aboutPage.sec2Desc: Founded in 1984, Sidefu is one of the world's most prestigious luxury hotel linen manufacturers, serving top global brands including Marriott, Hilton, InterContinental, Hyatt, and Kempinski with OEKO-TEX 100 Class 1 certified textiles.

solutionsPage.heroTitle: Turnkey Laundry Solutions for Every Scale
solutionsPage.heroDesc: From on-premise luxury resort laundries to 30-ton/day automated industrial central plants and healthcare-certified cleanroom bio-barriers.
solutionsPage.sol1Desc: Custom in-house plant layouts engineered for 200–1,000+ guest rooms. Combines soft-mount washers, high-speed chest ironers, and Sidefu 800T luxury linens to reduce linen replacement costs while guaranteeing plush guest satisfaction.
solutionsPage.sol2Desc: Hermetically sealed pass-through washer extractors designed to separate dirty intake rooms from sterile cleanroom pack-out areas, meeting strict ISO 14644-1 and European hospital disinfection norms.
solutionsPage.sol3Desc: Automated high-throughput washing and finishing lines for commercial linen rental companies and regional laundry plants, engineered with heat exchangers and water recycling systems to slash operating utility bills.

projectsPage.heroDesc: Explore our turnkey installations across luxury 5-star resorts, healthcare cleanrooms, central laundry plants, and the Shanghai WISER sample demonstration facility.
